format: JavaScript (ES module syntax with SvelteKit conventions)
description: This is a server-side source file for a SvelteKit page that handles fetching and responding to user actions for a public estimate portal. It includes load function to fetch estimate data using a token from URL parameters, and actions to accept or decline an estimate via API calls.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads estimate data using a token from URL params; fetches data from API and returns structured estimate info, or throws errors if token missing or fetch fails.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Handles POST request to accept the estimate, making an API call and returning success or error result.

methods.name: decline
methods.description: Handles POST request to decline the estimate, making an API call and returning success or error result.
